ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice came down to two factors. First, the task itself — generating a usable math problem from a given hypothesis — is completely benign, so Plover's distinctive strength (its aversion to harm-adjacent content) offers no advantage here. Second, with that differentiator removed, the decision reduces to raw capability, and Dunlin is meaningfully stronger across the board: higher public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.1, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 80.9) and higher internal evals on every dimension, including Creative Generation (84.7 vs 79.6). The user's irritated tone ("make it usable this time") signals they want a correct, well-formed result, which further favors the higher-capability model.
